scope: Visual language for all MealUp Food Portraits
frozenVisualInvariants: soft rounded cream vessel with controlled orange accents
single complete integrated recipe, never an ingredient collage
soft glossy stylized food with recognizable forms
same gauge housing language, segmented green-lime-yellow-orange-red arc, dark physical needle, visible pivot, central kcal value and orange secondary indicator
mobile-first square visual content and equivalent subject-to-canvas proportions
perRecipeVariables: recipe kcal number from the recipe card
gauge needle angle computed from the frozen mapping

gaugeBehavior.overflowPolicy: Values above 1000 remain at the maximum red position while the numeric kcal stays exact.
gaugeBehavior.colorDirection: Lower kcal points toward green; higher kcal points toward red.

explicitlyNotFrozen: the baked 480 text and baked needle angle in the owner source; production kcal and needle are dynamic
historical G5 vessel board affected by E08
individual Food Portraits other than the approved r2 reference
